name: FLUX.2-klein-4B OrbitQuant W4A4
notes: Data-agnostic PTQ (arxiv:2607.02461, Jul 2 2026). 4 variants: W4A4 (~3-4 GB), W3A3, W2A4, W2A3 (~2 GB). No calibration data needed. Apache 2.0. Requires ComfyUI v0.27.0 for OrbitQuant loader. Also available: W3A3 https://hf.co/WaveCut/FLUX.2-klein-4B-OrbitQuant-W3A3

name: FLUX.2-klein-9b-kv-fni8 (INT8 W8A8 DP4A)
notes: INT8 quantization of official FLUX.2-klein-9b-kv (KV-cache = 2.5x faster multi-reference editing). ~14-15 GB on 16 GB RTX 5060 Ti. Requires ComfyUI v0.27.0 Int8 loader. Zero community vetting — test before promoting to production.

name: LTX-2.3 (22B DiT, Lightricks)
notes: Major upgrade from LTX 0.9.x. 22B DiT with native audio-to-video. FP8 = 22 GB VRAM OVER BUDGET; NVFP4 = ~9 GB (RTX 5060 Ti Blackwell supports NVFP4). Requires Gemma 3 12B text encoder (CPU-offload-able). ComfyUI native support. NVFP4 path confirmed viable.

name: Wan 2.7 (Apache 2.0, Alibaba)
notes: Open-source Apache 2.0 release. Adds first/last-frame control (maps to build_wan_flf), 9-grid I2V, instruction editing. MoE A14B: 14B active/27B total -- FP16 OVER BUDGET; use GGUF Q4/Q5 community quantization. Dense T2V-5B ~5 GB. Primary source: ModelScope; community HF mirrors available.

name: SAM 3.1 Multiplex (Meta AI)
notes: Shared-memory joint multi-object tracking, up to 7x faster on multi-instance scenes. Natively in ComfyUI (PR #13408). New nodes: SAM3_Detect, SAM3_VideoTrack, SAM3_TrackToMask. Follow PR #13529 re: sageattention disable fix before deploying.

name: SeedVR2 int8_convrot weights (Comfy-Org/SeedVR2)
notes: Comfy-Org repo modified Jul 2 2026; HuggingFace discussion references new int8_convrot weights. Drop-in model swap for build_seedv2r. Requires ComfyUI v0.27.0. Verify actual weight files updated (may be README-only change).

name: SeedVR2-7B-bf16 / SeedVR2-3B-bf16 (community BF16)
notes: Community BF16 conversions of official ByteDance-Seed SeedVR2. 3B ~6-8 GB; 7B ~14-15 GB. Tagged arxiv:2506.03110. Alternative/complement to official int8_convrot path. Use official Comfy-Org path as primary.

name: ComfyUI v0.27.0 core update
notes: Int8 model loading for Turing+ GPUs (prerequisite for OrbitQuant, Klein KV INT8, SeedVR2 int8_convrot). Also adds LatentConcat, ConditioningMultiply, per-workflow seed nodes. Test custom node pack compatibility before upgrading production install.

name: LTX-Best-Face-ID LoRA (Alissonerdx)
notes: Identity-preserving reference-to-video on LTX-2.3. TASS-RoPE + ArcFace loss (arxiv:2606.02441). 63 likes. BFS Nodes ComfyUI pack required. LTX-2.3 upgrade is prerequisite. New builder opportunity: build_ltx_faceid_video.

name: ReActor HyperSwap ONNX (1a/1b/1c_256)
notes: HyperSwap 1a/1b/1c_256.onnx now supported in ReActor. Place in ComfyUI/models/hyperswap/. 1c_256 = quality tier. ReActor Core removes C++ Build Tools dependency. Exact date of HyperSwap feature addition unconfirmed but active as of Jul 2026.

name: BFS-Best-Face-Swap-Video V3 (Bernini-R 14B IC-LoRA)
notes: Diffusion-native video face swap via ByteDance Bernini-R 14B + IC-LoRA V3. Temporal identity consistency across all frames. 16 GB requires GGUF Q5_K_M (neuregex/Bernini-R-GGUF) + block-swap. ComfyUI-BerniniR node pack required. High integration cost but significant quality improvement over ReActor for video.

name: Krea 2 Identity Edit LoRA (conradlocke)
notes: Instruction-driven identity-preserving editing on Krea-2-Raw/Turbo. Keeps face/skin texture stable under re-staging, re-lighting, outfit changes. 117 likes. Krea-2-Turbo FP8 ~14-16 GB. Requires comfyui-krea2edit node pack. Keep generation <=2MP for identity stability.

name: WanVideo VACE 1.3B community fine-tune (wudi1122)
notes: ComfyUI diffusion-single-file format. Fine-tuned from Wan-AI/Wan2.1-VACE-1.3B. 362 downloads. ~4-6 GB VRAM. Training objective and data not documented -- treat as experimental. Existing VACE node wrappers apply.

name: flux-2-klein-9B-360-erp-outpaint-lora (nomadoor)
notes: 360 equirectangular panorama outpainting LoRA on existing Klein 9B checkpoint. 9.2K downloads, 47 likes. No new nodes needed -- pure LoRA add-on. Also: 4B variant at https://hf.co/nomadoor/flux-2-klein-4B-360-erp-outpaint-lora

name: Depth Anything 3 DA3-LARGE-1.1
notes: ICLR 2026. +35.7% camera accuracy, +23.6% geometric accuracy vs DA2. Apache 2.0 (DA3-Giant is CC BY-NC-4.0). Handles monocular/stereo/multi-view/video. ComfyUIDepthEstimation node support added Mar 2026 (v1.3.4). Model file swap in build_depth_map_v3.

name: Flux2-Klein-9B-True-V3 INT8 (wikeeyang)
notes: INT8 variants (int8_convrot, int8-mixedrow) uploaded Jul 7 2026. 31.5K downloads base repo. Aesthetic fine-tune of Klein 9B. INT8 ~15 GB on 16 GB budget. V3 community vetting sparse -- test before production use.

name: NVIDIA RTX Video Super Resolution (Comfy-Org/Nvidia_RTX_Nodes_ComfyUI)
notes: Official Comfy-Org + NVIDIA collab. RTX Tensor Core accelerated VSR/Denoise/Deblur, ~30x faster than diffusion upscalers. RTX 5060 Ti (Blackwell) compatible. Install via ComfyUI Manager search RTX. Optional install gate -- does not affect base workflow.

name: SeedVR2 v2.5 modular node redesign (numz)
notes: Modular node topology (replaces monolithic node). Adds GGUF quantization support enabling 7B model on 8 GB VRAM. Combined upgrade with int8_convrot weights (Tier 1.6) recommended. Node wiring in build_seedv2r needs updating.

name: FLUX.2-klein-9B manga colorization by reference LoRA (milo01)
notes: Reference-based colorization for manga/comic on Klein 9B. Niche use case. 12 downloads. Apache 2.0. Runs on existing Klein 9B checkpoint. Monitor for wider applicability reports.

name: Wan-Streamer v0.2 (arxiv:2607.04443)
notes: Official Alibaba Wan paper. Real-time streaming video from 192x336 -> 640x368 at same 200ms latency. Multi-GPU architecture (Ulysses context-parallel). NOT a standard diffusion T2V model -- live-streaming interactive agent system. No ComfyUI nodes. Monitor for distilled single-GPU port.

name: ID-LoRA: Identity-Driven Audio-Video Personalization (ECCV 2026)
notes: ECCV 2026. Generates talking video with custom voice+face from reference image+audio clip via LTX-2/2.3 Identity In-Context LoRA. Research code; no ComfyUI node pack. Monitor for ComfyUI wrapper.

name: SparkVSR: Keyframe-Conditioned Interactive VSR (arxiv:2603.16864)
notes: Paper only, no weights or ComfyUI nodes. Keyframe-conditioned video super-resolution with latent-pixel two-stage training. 18 HF upvotes. Monitor for weight release as potential SeedVR2 complement.

name: DreamID-V: Video Face Swapping via Diffusion Transformer (Jan 2026)
notes: 53 HF upvotes. DiT-based video face swap with Identity-Coherence Reinforcement Learning. No weights released. Watch for code/model drop -- if released would be strong candidate for new video face swap builder.

name: NTIRE 2026 Real-World Face Restoration Challenge (arxiv:2604.10532)
notes: 96 registrants, 10 valid submissions. Winning models advance SOTA for perceptual quality face restoration. Weights not yet publicly released. Monitor CVPR 2026 workshop code drops.

name: RoSE: Monocular Normal via Shading Sequence (arxiv:2602.09929)
notes: Reformulates normal estimation via image-to-video generative models. State-of-the-art on benchmarks. Paper only -- no HuggingFace weights or ComfyUI node. Monitor for weight release.

name: Hunyuan3D 2.5 LATTICE 10B shape model
notes: 10B shape foundation model -- OVER BUDGET at FP8 (~20+ GB). PBR texture model (Hunyuan3D-Paint 2.5) may fit in 16 GB. No Jul 2026 checkpoint update found. Monitor tencent/Hunyuan3D-2.5 for INT4/GGUF quantization.

name: OrbitQuant: Data-Agnostic Quantization for Diffusion Transformers (arxiv:2607.02461)
notes: Published Jul 2 2026. 36 HF upvotes. Applied to Klein 4B (WaveCut models, Tier 1.1). No calibration data needed. If community adopts for FLUX.1 Dev/Kontext, could create smaller checkpoints for build_img2img and build_qwen_edit.

name: Perceptual Flow Matching: Few-Step Generation (arxiv:2607.03524)
notes: 12 HF upvotes. Reduces sampling from 35-50 steps to 4-8 via perceptual feature space supervision. No weights yet. Watch for community distillations of Flux 1 Dev / Kontext.

name: Not All Tokens Need 40 Steps: Heterogeneous Step Allocation in DiTs (arxiv:2605.06892)
notes: Spatiotemporal token-level step allocation with KV-cache sync. Compatible with WAN/HunyuanVideo DiT architecture. No ComfyUI sampler node yet. Could reduce T2V/I2V generation time 20-40%.
